```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Packages and plotting theme
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(scales)

set.seed(123)

# Pretty colours
model_cols <- c(
  "M1" = "#E76F51",   # coral
  "M2" = "#2A9D8F",   # teal
  "M3" = "#6C63FF"    # purple
)

approach_cols <- c(
  "Model-specific" = "#F4A261",
  "Combined"       = "#457B9D"
)

# Consistent plot theme
theme_scdl <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 17,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5,
      colour = "grey35"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 15, 12, 15)
  )
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Model simulation functions
# ============================================================

# Draw theta from the prior
draw_theta <- function(model) {

  if (model == "M1") {
    return(rexp(1, rate = 1))
  }

  if (model == "M2") {
    return(rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = 1))
  }

  if (model == "M3") {
    return(rexp(1, rate = 1))
  }
}


# Generate a dataset conditional on theta
simulate_data <- function(model, theta, n) {

  if (model == "M1") {

    # Exponential(theta), theta interpreted as RATE
    return(
      rexp(n, rate = theta)
    )

  }

  if (model == "M2") {

    # Lognormal(theta, 1)
    # theta = meanlog
    return(
      rlnorm(
        n,
        meanlog = theta,
        sdlog = 1
      )
    )

  }

  if (model == "M3") {

    # Gamma(shape = 2, theta)
    # theta interpreted as RATE
    return(
      rgamma(
        n,
        shape = 2,
        rate = theta
      )
    )

  }
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. Summary statistics
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach 1:
# Model-specific sufficient statistic
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_specific <- function(y, model) {

  if (model == "M1") {

    return(sum(y))

  }

  if (model == "M2") {

    return(sum(log(y)))

  }

  if (model == "M3") {

    return(sum(y))

  }
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach 2:
# Combined summary statistic
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_combined <- function(y) {

  c(
    sum_y     = sum(y),
    sum_log_y = sum(log(y)),
    sum_log2  = sum(log(y)^2)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. ABC reference table
# ============================================================

N_ABC <- 30000
n <- 50

# Equal prior probability for the three models
ref_model <- sample(
  c("M1", "M2", "M3"),
  size = N_ABC,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)
)

# Storage
ref_theta <- numeric(N_ABC)

ref_specific <- numeric(N_ABC)

ref_combined <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = N_ABC,
  ncol = 3
)

colnames(ref_combined) <- c(
  "sum_y",
  "sum_log_y",
  "sum_log2"
)


# Generate prior predictive simulations
for (i in seq_len(N_ABC)) {

  m <- ref_model[i]

  theta <- draw_theta(m)

  y_sim <- simulate_data(
    model = m,
    theta = theta,
    n = n
  )

  ref_theta[i] <- theta

  ref_specific[i] <-
    summary_specific(y_sim, m)

  ref_combined[i, ] <-
    summary_combined(y_sim)
}


reference_table <- data.frame(
  model = ref_model,
  theta = ref_theta,
  specific = ref_specific,
  sum_y = ref_combined[, 1],
  sum_log_y = ref_combined[, 2],
  sum_log2 = ref_combined[, 3]
)

head(reference_table)
```

```{r}
specific_sd
```

```{r}
combined_sd <- apply(
  ref_combined,
  2,
  sd
)

combined_sd
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. ABC Approach 1
# ============================================================

abc_specific <- function(y_obs, accept_rate = 0.01) {

  distances <- numeric(N_ABC)

  for (m in c("M1", "M2", "M3")) {

    rows <- which(reference_table$model == m)

    # Observed statistic appropriate for this candidate model
    obs_stat <- summary_specific(
      y_obs,
      m
    )

    sd_m <- specific_sd$sd_specific[
      specific_sd$model == m
    ]

    distances[rows] <-
      abs(
        reference_table$specific[rows] -
          obs_stat
      ) / sd_m
  }

  # Accept closest simulations
  n_accept <- ceiling(
    N_ABC * accept_rate
  )

  accepted <-
    order(distances)[1:n_accept]

  posterior <-
    table(
      factor(
        reference_table$model[accepted],
        levels = c("M1", "M2", "M3")
      )
    ) / n_accept

  as.numeric(posterior) |>
    setNames(
      c("M1", "M2", "M3")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. ABC Approach 2
# ============================================================

abc_combined <- function(y_obs, accept_rate = 0.01) {

  obs_summary <-
    summary_combined(y_obs)

  # Standardised Euclidean distance
  standardised_difference <-
    sweep(
      ref_combined,
      2,
      obs_summary,
      FUN = "-"
    )

  standardised_difference <-
    sweep(
      standardised_difference,
      2,
      combined_sd,
      FUN = "/"
    )

  distances <-
    sqrt(
      rowSums(
        standardised_difference^2
      )
    )

  n_accept <-
    ceiling(
      N_ABC * accept_rate
    )

  accepted <-
    order(distances)[1:n_accept]

  posterior <-
    table(
      factor(
        reference_table$model[accepted],
        levels = c("M1", "M2", "M3")
      )
    ) / n_accept

  as.numeric(posterior) |>
    setNames(
      c("M1", "M2", "M3")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot 1: Posterior probabilities for ONE observed dataset
# ============================================================

single_result <- data.frame(
  Model = rep(
    c("M1", "M2", "M3"),
    2
  ),
  Probability = c(
    post_specific,
    post_combined
  ),
  Approach = rep(
    c(
      "Model-specific",
      "Combined"
    ),
    each = 3
  )
)


p1 <- ggplot(
  single_result,
  aes(
    x = Model,
    y = Probability,
    fill = Approach
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = percent(
        Probability,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.45,
    size = 4.3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = approach_cols
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(),
    limits = c(0, 1.08),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "ABC posterior model probabilities",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Observed data generated from ",
      true_model,
      "  |  n = ",
      n,
      "  |  true theta = ",
      round(theta_true, 3)
    ),
    x = "Candidate model",
    y = "Posterior probability",
    fill = "ABC approach"
  ) +

  theme_scdl +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )


p1
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9. Repeated simulation experiment
# ============================================================

R <- 100

run_one_experiment <- function(
    true_model,
    replicate_id,
    n = 50,
    accept_rate = 0.01
) {

  # Draw true theta from corresponding prior
  theta_true <-
    draw_theta(true_model)

  # Generate observed dataset
  y_obs <-
    simulate_data(
      model = true_model,
      theta = theta_true,
      n = n
    )

  # ABC Approach 1
  p_specific <-
    abc_specific(
      y_obs,
      accept_rate
    )

  # ABC Approach 2
  p_combined <-
    abc_combined(
      y_obs,
      accept_rate
    )

  # Store results
  bind_rows(

    data.frame(
      replicate = replicate_id,
      true_model = true_model,
      theta_true = theta_true,
      approach = "Model-specific",
      M1 = p_specific["M1"],
      M2 = p_specific["M2"],
      M3 = p_specific["M3"]
    ),

    data.frame(
      replicate = replicate_id,
      true_model = true_model,
      theta_true = theta_true,
      approach = "Combined",
      M1 = p_combined["M1"],
      M2 = p_combined["M2"],
      M3 = p_combined["M3"]
    )

  )
}
set.seed(123)

results <- map_dfr(
  c("M1", "M2", "M3"),
  function(m) {

    map_dfr(
      1:R,
      function(r) {

        run_one_experiment(
          true_model = m,
          replicate_id = r,
          n = n,
          accept_rate = 0.01
        )

      }
    )
  }
)

head(results)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 10. Probability assigned to true model
# ============================================================

results <- results %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    prob_true = case_when(

      true_model == "M1" ~ M1,

      true_model == "M2" ~ M2,

      true_model == "M3" ~ M3

    ),

    selected_model =
      c("M1", "M2", "M3")[
        which.max(
          c(M1, M2, M3)
        )
      ],

    correct =
      selected_model == true_model

  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
